title: The Soul and the Body are One and the Same
html:
• Saṁyutta Nikāya 24.13 Linked Discourses 24.13
  • 1. Sotāpattivagga 1. Stream-Entry

Taṁjīvaṁtaṁsarīraṁsutta The Soul and the Body are One and the Same

Sāvatthinidānaṁ. At Sāvatthī.

“Kismiṁ nu kho, bhikkhave, sati, kiṁ upādāya, kiṁ abhinivissa evaṁ diṭṭhi uppajjati: “Mendicants, when what exists, because of grasping what and insisting on what, does the view arise: ‘taṁ jīvaṁ taṁ sarīran’”ti? ‘The soul and the body are one and the same’?” …

“Bhagavaṁmūlakā no, bhante, dhammā …pe… niyato sambodhiparāyano”ti.

Terasamaṁ.
